description: This file defines the internal internals of PDF objects within the PdfSharp library, providing access to object identifiers, object numbers, generation numbers, and type identification for internal PDF data structures.

classes.name: PdfObjectInternals
classes.description: Provides access to internal PDF object data structures, encapsulating details like object ID, number, generation, and type.

methods.name: PdfObjectInternals
methods.description: Constructor initializing internal PDF object internals with a given PdfObject.

methods.name: ObjectID
methods.description: Property that returns the object identifier, or empty if the object is a direct object.

methods.name: ObjectNumber
methods.description: Property that returns the object number from the ObjectID.

methods.name: GenerationNumber
methods.description: Property that returns the generation number from the ObjectID.

methods.name: TypeID
methods.description: Property that determines the type of the PDF object, such as 'array', 'dictionary', or the class name.
